items.title: Andrew Bailey Interview, 1959-09-26
items.q: He was a good cornet player too, Buddy Petit. Yeah, I knew him good.

ctx.x: Well Buddy Petit, he was a good cornet player. He had a contract by the Percy Brinshall. He used to play downtown, Percy Brinshall. He was a good cornet player too, Buddy Petit. Yeah, I knew him good.
Did you ever get across Canal Street to go to any of the dances uptown on Rampart Street?
